description: The pie chart depicts the distribution of video types in a dataset, shown as 14 labeled categories with percentage values printed inside each slice and the category names placed around the circumference (no separate legend is present, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized). Clockwise from the top, the slices are: Howto Style (green, ~9.7%), People Blogs (orange, ~17.2%), Music (light purple, ~2.3%), Autos Vehicles (red, ~4.8%), Pets Animals (green, ~3.9%), News Politics (orange, ~4.3%), Science Technology (blue, ~6.4%), Comedy (cyan, ~5.6%), Travel Events (yellow, ~4.6%), Gaming (gray, ~6.4%), Sports (pink, ~7.7%), Film Animation (brown, ~4.6%), Entertainment (purple, ~13.9%), and Education (red, ~8.7%); the segments appear arranged in a clockwise sequence by category rather than in an obvious strictly ascending or descending order by slice size.
